assets.name: stick

assets.prompt: Production transparent UI icon for the Battle Cities PSG1 controls guide. Input 1 is the user's actual PSG1 product, input 2 approved guide for style. Create ONE isolated LEFT/RIGHT reusable analog stick, head-on nearly orthographic view. Match actual PSG1: matte charcoal BLACK low circular rubber thumb cap, smooth mildly concave textured center, rounded black rim, a narrow translucent periwinkle-PURPLE mounting ring visible around it. Strong circular silhouette, physical molded plastic/rubber; subtle upper-left studio light and small integrated lower depth. No electric-blue metal, no cyan glow. No arrows, letters, markings, hands, device casing beyond the tiny mounting ring, text, labels or other objects. Cream-panel game UI clarity at 48–96 logical units. Center and tightly crop with about 4% safe transparent margins. One object on genuinely transparent background, all edges intact, no fake checkerboard. Square source, polished friendly illustrated hardware rendering matching purple PSG1 controls. Do not render a whole joystick with a long stalk.

assets.name: dpad

Four tiny PALE LAVENDER triangular direction markers physically inset in the arms, pointing UP/LEFT/DOWN/RIGHT respectively. These are intrinsic D-pad symbols, not a caption. Tight small transparent margins around full cross with soft minimal depth shadow; actual alpha transparency. Single centered object, square high-resolution source.
